description: Find all NIH research grants awarded to a specific university, hospital, or research institute. Provide the institution name (partial uppercase match supported, e.g. "JOHNS HOPKINS", "MAYO CLINIC", "MIT"). Optionally filter by fiscal year or active status. Returns award amount, PI, title, and activity code.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year to filter (e.g. 2024). NIH fiscal year runs Oct 1 – Sep 30

is_active.description: When true, return only currently active/ongoing projects

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip (default 0)

org_name.description: Institution or university name to search (e.g. "JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY", "HARVARD UNIVERSITY", "MAYO CLINIC"). Partial uppercase match.

name: nihreporter.projects.by_org

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: NIH Grants by Institution
